shortDescription: Create, update or delete devices within Nautobot

options.name: api_version
options.description: API Version Nautobot REST API

options.name: asset_tag
options.description: Asset tag that is associated to the device

options.name: clusters
options.description: List of clusters to associate with this device.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments that may include additional information in regards to the device

options.name: controller_managed_device_group
options.description: Device controller_managed_device_group the device will be assigned to Requires Nautobot C(v2.2) or later

options.name: custom_fields
options.description: Must exist in Nautobot and in key/value format

options.name: device_redundancy_group
options.description: Device redundancy group the device will be assigned to

options.name: device_redundancy_group_priority
options.description: Priority in the assigned device redundancy group

options.name: device_type
options.description: Required if I(state=present) and the device does not exist yet Recommended when updating or deleting if not using I(id) or I(name) to aid with identification

options.name: face
options.description: Required if I(rack) is defined

options.name: id
options.description: The UUID of the object to operate on

options.name: local_config_context_data
options.description: Arbitrary JSON data to define the devices configuration variables.

options.name: location
options.description: Required if I(state=present) and the device does not exist yet Recommended when updating or deleting if not using I(id) or I(name) to aid with identification

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the device

options.name: platform
options.description: The platform of the device

options.name: position
options.description: The position of the device in the rack defined above

options.name: primary_ip4
options.description: Primary IPv4 address assigned to the device

options.name: primary_ip6
options.description: Primary IPv6 address assigned to the device

options.name: query_params
options.description: This can be used to override the specified values in ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS that is defined in plugins/module_utils/utils.py and provides control to users on what may make an object unique in their environment.

options.name: rack
options.description: The name of the rack to assign the device to

options.name: role
options.description: Required if I(state=present) and the device does not exist yet Recommended when updating or deleting if not using I(id) or I(name) to aid with identification

options.name: secrets_group
options.description: The secrets_group of the device

options.name: serial
options.description: Serial number of the device

options.name: software_image_files
options.description: Override the software image files associated with the software version for this inventory item

options.name: software_version
options.description: The software version associated with the device

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing.

options.name: status
options.description: The status of the device Required if I(state=present) and the device does not exist yet

options.name: tags
options.description: Any tags that this item may need to be associated with

options.name: tenant
options.description: The tenant that the device will be assigned to

options.name: token
options.description: The token created within Nautobot to authorize API access Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_TOKEN) environment variable is configured.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Nautobot instance resolvable by the Ansible host (for example: http://nautobot.example.com:8000) Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_URL) environment variable is configured.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_VALIDATE_CERTS) environment variable is configured.

options.name: vc_position
options.description: Position in the assigned virtual chassis

options.name: vc_priority
options.description: Priority in the assigned virtual chassis

options.name: virtual_chassis
options.description: Virtual chassis the device will be assigned to

options.name: vrfs
options.description: List of VRFs to associate with this device.
